chunks: They await but a single blast which will not be repeated.

key_terms.صَيْحَةً: A loud cry or blast (of the angel Israfil)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'saihah wahidah' in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the abrupt transition from worldly life to the afterlife, emphasizing that death or the final trumpet blast will catch humanity unprepared, leaving no time for repentance or delay. It serves as a spiritual warning to remain vigilant and spiritually ready at all times, rather than assuming one has ample time for spiritual preparation.
